messages:
maria: FYI — stakeholder call this morning pushed for SSO + advanced routing in MVP. we should discuss what actually ships in MVP vs v1.

sam: ugh, advanced routing is a big lift. can we decouple it and ship SSO+basic routing in MVP? :thinking_face:

taylor: +1 to decouple. routing has infra + ui deps (route config UI, policies).

priya: to be explicit: MVP goal is "usable for customers to onboard with SSO and predictable latency". advanced routing is a quality-of-life feature, not blocking onboarding.

jen: agree. propose cutlist for MVP: remove routing UI, keep API + simple policy defaults. keep audit logs, KMS integration stays.

maria: draft cutlist (quick):
```
- MVP: SSO (SSO pilot flow), audit logs, KMS, basic route matching (defaults only)
- Cut from MVP -> move to v1: routing UI, per-tenant custom policies, routing analytics dashboard
- v1 target: add canary rollout for custom policies, analytics
```

sam: timeline implication? product milestone 2026-06-10 was tight. removing features helps, but we still need time for e2e SSO testing + compliance review.

priya: realistic timeline if we cut routing UI: shift release by 2 weeks for compliance gating + cleanup. so new soft date 2026-06-24.

jen: ops comment: release-bot will need updated rollout config. also we must land a fallback model if the SSO pilot has errors.

release-bot: scheduled canary window updated: 2026-06-24 -> 2026-07-01, 3-day canary, automatic rollback on 5% error spike.

maria: ok — sounds reasonable. quick risk register entries:
- Risk: customers expecting per-tenant routing now — mitigation: communicate limited default routing in pilot docs + product FAQ.
- Risk: audit/compliance delays — mitigation: parallel review with security, prioritize KMS + logging PRs.

sam: action items: @taylor to own routing UI removal PR; @priya to confirm compliance slot; @jen to update rollout config; @maria to own customer comms and release notes.

taylor: started branch: `cut/routing-ui-mvp` with TODOs in code and an integration test skipped.

priya: booked security review: 2026-06-08 10:00 PT. added checklist item: KMS key rotation proof.

jen: updating release playbook now. will add rollback steps and a scoreboard for latency thresholds.

maria: can we keep a tiny telemetry flag to measure how many customers request per-tenant routing during pilot? we can use that input to prioritize v1.

sam: yes add a telemetry event `routing_request_clicked` and wire to pilot analytics. low overhead.

priya: one more ask: if we shift milestone, can we still keep a small internal alpha before public pilot? say 1 week earlier for a handful of customers.

maria: good call. internal alpha 2026-06-17, public pilot 2026-06-24 -> canary 2026-07-01 per release-bot.

release-bot: note: deploy freeze 2026-06-20 -> 2026-06-28 for compliance window. exceptions via oncall.

sam: seems we have alignment. anything else?

jen: I'll send updated release checklist and a short blurb for customer comms by EOD.

maria: thanks team — i'll update the milestone tracker and ping sales/solutions with the scope change. :v:
